facts.text: Olechowski, Eppinger and Joglekar interviewed 19 practitioners in seven organizations in 2015 and followed with a best-worst survey in 2020 to study challenges with TRLs as a measurement.

facts.text: A TRL is not a complete measure of system readiness: a component can be mature while integration, representative data, model credibility, scenario coverage, configuration management, tooling and safety argumentation remain immature.

facts.text: For a virtual-testing capability, assign TRLs only to genuinely novel critical technologies, such as a new plant model, an automated scenario generator, a sensor model or a real-time hardware-in-the-loop component.

facts.text: Never give a whole virtual-testing programme one average TRL.
